1.e4 e5 2.d4 exd4 3.Nf3 c5 4.Bc4.strategy: Develops the bishop at f7, defended only by the king, while the knight keeps the d4 pawn under attack. Black's c-pawn holds d4 but leaves d5 unguarded for White's bishop and pieces, so Black has to meet the pressure accurately.
